verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own GitHub and GitLab integrations sync issues into ClickUp, which gives a partial consolidated view of work from issue trackers. The Asana and Jira integrations are one-time migrations, not live aggregation, and the cross-tool analytics listing (ClickUp, Linear, GitHub) is a third-party reporting app. Missing for 10: a live unified 'my assigned tasks' view across dedicated PM tools like Jira, Asana or Linear; ongoing sync of assignees from those tools; hands-on corroboration that synced issues appear in a personal assigned view.
